name: application-stat-tile
title: Stat Tile
description: Single KPI tile with a typed label/value/delta prop contract for building your own dashboard stat grids without hand-editing markup.
useWhen: Composing a custom grid of KPI tiles where each tile's label, value, and trend come from real data.
You need a single reusable stat primitive instead of copying and re-editing a pre-built multi-card layout.
Building an admin or analytics dashboard summary row from a list of metrics.
avoidWhen: You want a ready-made multi-card layout out of the box — use application-stats instead.
The value changes frequently in real time — a static tile without live updates can mislead users.
Detailed breakdown of the metric is needed on the same view — use a table or chart instead.
responsiveBehavior: The tile is a single block with intrinsic sizing; place it in your own responsive grid (e.g. a CSS grid or flex wrap) to control column count at each breakpoint.
accessibility: The label and value are read in document order, so screen readers announce them together as one stat.
Growth direction uses both an icon and a visually hidden text label (Increase/Decrease/No change), not color alone.
Decorative icons carry aria-hidden='true'; the delta text label carries the meaning for assistive technology.

variants.title: Stat tile
variants.description: Single KPI tile taking label, value, an optional delta object, and an optional icon slot as typed props.
accessibility: Growth badge color is supplementary; the visually hidden direction word and delta text communicate the change to screen readers.

variants.title: Stat tile (Dark)
variants.description: Single KPI tile with label/value/delta/icon props adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Value, label, and growth badge colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
